page: Microsoft Azure E20ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at up to 4.2 GHz. The hardware configuration allocates 20 dedicated virtual CPUs across 10 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The processor architecture includes 48 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and a large 260 MB shared L3 cache, alongside specialized instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX).

System memory totals 160.0 GB, maintaining an 8.0 GB per-vCPU ratio characteristic of memory-optimized cloud instances. The instance features 1182 GB of attached local NVMe SSD storage, providing high-speed scratch space for disk-intensive operations. There are no discrete hardware GPUs present. Networking configurations do not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark testing indicates consistent performance across standard compute and memory tasks. Single-threaded gzip compression scored in the top 25% at 31.28 GB/sec, while LLM text generation throughput on small models reached the top 10% tier at 393.88 tokens per second. General compute metrics, including a multi-core Geekbench score of 11504.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 32372.66, placed in the middle 50%. Memory bandwidth tests recorded 150.84 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads and 78.61 GB/sec for large block writes.

The provision of 8 GB of RAM per vCPU alongside 1182 GB of fast NVMe storage delivers balanced resource efficiency for memory-heavy environments that also require local caching. The absence of hardware acceleration makes it unsuitable for large-scale GPU tasks, but the configuration fits relational database workloads, in-memory caches like Redis, ETL pipelines, and enterprise application hosting.
description: Microsoft Azure E20ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 20 dedicated vCPUs and 10 physical cores driven by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor clocked at 4.2 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture with Intel AMX and AVX-512 extensions, it includes a 260 MB L3 cache, 160.0 GB of system memory, and 1182 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD storage. It operates without discrete GPUs. In benchmark evaluations, the E20ds_v6 demonstrates competitive throughput, reaching 31.28 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip compression and achieving 393.88 tokens per second in small model LLM text generation. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 150.84 GB/sec alongside solid multi-core CPU metrics. The substantial memory density combined with fast local storage makes this server well configured for relational databases, Redis caching layers, enterprise backend services, and intermediate ETL data processing.
